case.documentation: A blob with a @mediaType is sent verbatim, as that media type.
A blob with a @mediaType is returned verbatim, as that media type.
The response body is the blob, verbatim, as application/octet-stream.
An empty blob is an empty body, still labelled application/octet-stream.
The request body is the blob, verbatim, as application/octet-stream.
An empty blob is an empty body.
A declared error raised before a stream starts is an ordinary error response.
Label, query, header and prefix-header bindings are read alongside a JSON body.
Header, prefix-header and response-code bindings are written alongside a JSON body.
A declared error gets its @httpError status, its header bindings and the error type header.
An @httpPayload structure is the whole request body.
An @httpPayload structure is the whole response body, under the operation's @http code.
Query parameters bound by @httpQueryParams.
Each value is the data of one event, under text/event-stream, and the terminator's event follows the last.
A stream with no values is the terminator's event alone.
@jsonName renames a union's tag and a structure's member.
A timestamp is epoch seconds by default, and @timestampFormat picks another format.
A member left out takes its @default when read.
An explicit null in a @nullable member is kept, and written back.
A @discriminated union puts its tag in the named field, beside the member's own.
An @untagged union is the member's value alone.
A union's @jsonUnknown member holds a tag the union doesn't declare, and writes it back as it was.
A structure's @jsonUnknown map holds the members the structure doesn't declare, and writes them back beside the rest.
An @openEnum, string and int. Only declared values: Smithy's node validation doesn't know @openEnum and rejects any other value in params, so reading an undeclared one can't be written as a case.
@uuidFormat, @dateFormat, @localTimeFormat, @durationSecondsFormat and @offsetDateTimeFormat.
A @preserveKeyOrder document. Bodies are compared as JSON, where key order doesn't count, so this only checks such a document is read and written at all.
A @uuidFormat string that isn't a UUID fails the stream: {"formats":{"id":"nope",...}}\n
Without a terminator, the stream ends with the last value's event.
Without a terminator, the stream ends with the last value's event.
Each value is one line of JSON, newline-terminated, under application/x-ndjson, with the envelope's bindings on the request.
A stream with no values is an empty body.
Each value is one line of JSON, newline-terminated, under application/x-ndjson, with the envelope's bindings on the response.
A stream with no values is an empty body.
@httpResponseCode on the envelope sets the status of a streamed response.
A line may end in \r\n: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}\r\n
The last line may lack its newline: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}
A line that is not JSON fails the stream: not json\n
A line naming a member the union doesn't have fails the stream: {"mystery":{}}\n
A value missing a @required member fails the stream: {"progress":{}}\n
A value outside its @range fails the stream: {"progress":{"soFar":-1}}\n
Each value is the data of one event, under text/event-stream, and the terminator's event follows the last.
A stream with no values is the terminator's event alone.

A comment and an event without data deliver nothing: :keep-alive

id: 1

The event, id and retry fields are skipped: event: progress
id: 7
retry: 1000
data: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}

An event's data fields are joined with newlines: data: {"progress":
data: {"soFar":1}}

Lines may end in 
: data: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}
Lines may end in \r: data: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}\r\r
The space after a field's colon is optional: data:{"progress":{"soFar":1}}\n\n
A byte order mark at the start of the stream is skipped: \uFEFFdata: {"progress":{"soFar":1}}\n\n
An event cut off before its blank line is not delivered: data: {"progress":{"soFar":2}}\n at the end of the stream.
Data that is not JSON fails the stream: data: not json\n\n
